summary: The registrant filed a Form 6-K containing a notice of its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders and proxy statement. The meeting will be held on July 1, 2026, to ratify financial statements, appoint a director to replace resigning members, and transact other business. The chairperson beneficially owns 100% of Class B shares and intends to vote them for all proposals. The board recommends voting in favor. This is a routine annual shareholder meeting notice with no special-situation event. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report of a proxy statement, not an acquisition, restructuring, or other special situation.
